title: Crime and Punishment
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
firstLine: On an exceptionally hot evening early in July a young man came out of the garret in which he lodged in S. Place and walked slowly, as though in hesitation, towards K. bridge.
begins: On a hot July evening in St. Petersburg, a young man slips out of his cramped garret past his landlady, to whom he is hopelessly in debt, and walks slowly toward a bridge, overstrained and cut off from other people.
happens: Raskolnikov, a destitute student, murders an old pawnbroker and her sister with an axe. Fevered and guilt-ridden, he is drawn to the drunken Marmeladov’s family, especially his daughter Sonia. His mother Pulcheria and his sister Dounia come to St. Petersburg, where Dounia’s fiancé Luzhin is exposed as a schemer. His friend Razumihin helps them; Porfiry Petrovitch, the head of the Investigation Department, suspects him; Svidrigaïlov, who pursues Dounia, learns the secret and later shoots himself. Urged by Sonia, Raskolnikov confesses and gets eight years’ penal servitude in Siberia, where she follows him and he begins to be renewed.

characters.name: Sonia
characters.who: Marmeladov’s daughter, who follows him to Siberia
